id: 2629
title: To George Lillie Craik
display-date: April 25th [187?] [[footnote:1]]
from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
from-address: Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.
to-name: To George Lillie Craik
manuscript-location: 'MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 9'

Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379),

I am much obliged for the cheque, I feel as if I hardly deserved it after all the trouble I have given [Mr Freeman](/person/523).[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The year is hard to read and the letter has been filed under 1875.
[^2]: CMY\'s [History of France](/book/99) had been heavily revised after criticism from E. A.

Freeman, the editor of the \'Historical Course for Schools\' series.
